description: Finds servers on the board by words in their name, title, description or host, with optional filters, sorted by exact Claude token cost (highest first) by default. Use it to discover servers or to compare costs; use lookup_server once you have a name. Returns up to 20 servers per page with name, host, status, tool count and tokens. Page numbers go to 20; after that pass the `next` value of the previous answer as `cursor`. Sorting by the estimate, latency, protocol or registry date needs a query or a small status; on a bigger list the answer keeps the token order and says so in `sort`.

cursor.description: The `next` value of a previous answer, to continue from there; replaces page

page.description: Page number, 1 to 20, twenty servers each; default 1. Not with cursor.

query.description: Words to match, three or more characters each, as prefixes: "git copilot" finds the GitHub Copilot servers. Omit for the whole list.

sort.description: claude = exact Claude tokens, highest first (default); claude-asc = lowest first; tokens = the o200k_base estimate; tools = tool count; latency = initialize time; name; updated = registry date

status.description: ok = answers and lists tools; auth = needs credentials; payment = 402; newer_protocol = a protocol newer than the SDK; down = every other failure. Omit for all.

name: search_servers

next.description: The cursor for the next page, when hasNext

page.description: The page number, absent when a cursor was used

claudeTokens.description: Exact count from the Anthropic count_tokens endpoint, names as published

page.description: The server's page on the board

protocolVersion.description: The MCP protocol version the server negotiated

status.description: ok (answered initialize and tools/list), auth (needs credentials), payment (402), not_found, protocol_error (not MCP), timeout, dns, tls, refused, server_error, rate_limited, newer_protocol; package servers also install_failed, no_bin, needs_env, needs_args, needs_network, crashed

toolsTokens.description: o200k_base estimate over the compact JSON of the tool definitions; the exact count is about 1.9 times this at the median

title: Search the registry board
